description: Active and upcoming US Temporary Flight Restrictions whose area intersects a bounding box, as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection: polygon per restricted area with altitude band (feet + AGL/MSL), effective time and valid_until, NOTAM id, type and facility. Fuses the FAA TFR list with each NOTAM's boundary geometry. For drone/flight-ops corridor pre-flight checks. Not for operational flight planning. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (Base); the first 5 calls per day per client are free.

active_only.description: Optional: true to drop upcoming (not-yet-effective) TFRs

alt_ft.description: Optional: only TFRs whose altitude band includes this height in feet

bbox.description: Query box minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat in WGS84 decimal degrees

buffer_nm.description: Optional: expand the query box by this many nautical miles

name: tfr_corridor
title: US TFRs intersecting a geographic box (GeoJSON)
